messages:
olivia: Heads-up: SA-1 warm-pool is churning and dozens of nodes are failing bootstrap since ~02:08 UTC. Warm-pool kept scaling and we're burning GPU minutes. Suspect a recent security policy roll.

hassan: Any agent logs or flow evidence?

olivia: node-agent snippets: 
```
[2026-03-22T02:09:01Z] keystore: decrypt failed: KMS.AccessDenied: policy condition 'resource.tags.compliance=="yes"' not met
[2026-03-22T02:09:01Z] bootstrap: attestation aborted
[2026-03-22T02:09:02Z] audit-exporter: POST https://audit-collector.internal/v1/ingest -> 503 Service Unavailable
```

ops-bot: Alert: 53 nodes failing bootstrap in south-america-1 (>4m). Warm-pool scale-up rate elevated.

claire: Cross-checking: security deployed a KMS key policy tweak at 01:45 to require compliance tag, and a VPC endpoint policy for the audit collector was narrowed at 01:50 to a small principal set. Also saw a firewall inline change to drop "suspicious TLS signatures" at 01:55. Potential triple-interaction.

hassan: That ordering is dangerous. If policy change landed before infra tags were applied and before endpoint exceptions were made, new nodes would never complete bootstrap. Can we confirm subnet tags?

olivia: Confirmed: many SA prod subnets are missing the new compliance=yes tag. The collector VPC endpoint policy doesn't include infra-cert-proxy or node-agent principals, and the fw rule signature apparently matches node-agent TLS handshake (false positive).

cost-watch: Quick estimate: current churn projected to add ~640 GPU-minutes in the next hour (~$950). Recommend immediate intervention.

hassan: Mitigation plan (short): 1) temporarily widen KMS key policy to allow infra-node-role in SA 2) add VPC endpoint policy exception for infra-cert-proxy and audit-collector calls 3) add fw SG exception for node-agent cert CN 4) pause warm-pool autoscaling and restart stuck nodes in small batches. Who can take 1 & 2?

claire: I can file the immediate KMS patch and the endpoint policy patch (temp). Olivia, can you apply subnet tags and pause autoscaling?

olivia: Applying tags to the three affected subnets now: `aws ec2 create-tags --resources subnet-aaa subnet-bbb subnet-ccc --tags Key=compliance,Value=yes --region south-america-1`. Pausing warm-pool autoscaling: `aws autoscaling update-auto-scaling-group --auto-scaling-group-name sa-warm-pool --max-size 84 --min-size 20 --region south-america-1`.

claire: Patching KMS policy (temp allow) and endpoint policy to include infra principals. Command: `aws kms put-key-policy --key-id abcd-1234 --policy file://temp-allow-infra.json --region south-america-1` and `aws ec2 modify-vpc-endpoint --vpc-endpoint-id vpce-0abc --policy-document file://open-audit-endpoint.json --region south-america-1`.

ops-bot: Incident created: INFRA-9240  SA warm-pool bootstrap failures due to policy ordering + fw false-positive.

hassan: After both patches and tag application, start a rolling restart: restart 10 agents at a time to clear exponential backoff. Also add a transient limiter to warm-pool so it can't scale beyond current size for 20m.

olivia: Restarting batch 1/6. Watching logs. Flow logs now show ACCEPT for previous REJECTs; keystore decrypts begin to succeed.

claire: KMS/endpoint changes applied. Audit collector accepts now from infra principals. Noted the fw rule false positive signature; I've added an exception rule allowing tag:Service=node-agent -> audit-collector:443.

cost-watch: Updated projection: with mitigations in place, expected extra ~190 GPU-minutes (~$280).

hassan: Quick post-incident actions: 1) require tag presence check in policy rollout CI 2) add a deploy-ordering playbook for security->infra handoffs 3) add presubmit tests: simulate node bootstrap under sampling/endpoint policy toggles and add a fw-rule fingerprint regression test 4) metric: keystore.decrypt.accept_rate (30s) and audit-collector.ingest.accept_rate (30s) alerts. I'll own 2 & 4; claire owns 1 & 3. Ticket INFRA-9240 updated with owners.

olivia: Monitoring stable so far; warm-pool scaled back down and join rate normalized. Leaving INFRA-9240 open for RCA and runbook updates. Thanks team. :thumbsup:
